ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p175/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p175/r2.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p175/r2.claim: Noah's being trustworthy means either that his people already knew his reliability or that he is entrusted with delivering God's message.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p175/r2.anchor: وأمانته، كونه مشهورا في قومه بذلك، أو مؤتمنا على أداء رسالة الله

RAZI-FULL:v24p133/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v24p133/r7.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v24p133/r7.claim: Noah reminds them he is a trustworthy messenger, as Muhammad was known among Quraysh: they knew Noah’s honesty before his call, so should not accuse him now.
RAZI-FULL:v24p133/r7.anchor: وذلك لأنه كان فيهم مشهورا بالأمانة كمحمد صلى الله عليه وسلم في قريش

BURSEVI:v6p211#4/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p211#4/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p211#4/r2.claim: Noah was publicly known as trustworthy; one trustworthy in worldly matters is trustworthy in revelation and the message.
BURSEVI:v6p211#4/r2.anchor: مشهور بالأمانة فيما بينكم ومن كان أمينا على أمور الدنيا كان أمينا على الوحي والرسالة.

STUDYQURAN:26:107/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:26:107/r1.speaker: Q, R
STUDYQURAN:26:107/r1.claim: Noah was trustworthy because his people had known him throughout his life and had no reason to mistrust him, just as Muhammad was known among Quraysh; he had always been truthful.
STUDYQURAN:26:107/r1.anchor: Noah was trustworthy because being one of his people, he was known to them all his life, just as Muhammad was among the Quraysh

TAB-FULL:v17p601#2/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v17p601#2/r2.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v17p601#2/r2.claim: Noah is a messenger from God and trustworthy with the revelation and message entrusted to him for his people.
TAB-FULL:v17p601#2/r2.anchor: الله {أمين} [الأعراف: 68] على وحيه إلي، برسالته إياي إليكم.

TABATABAI:26:105-110/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:26:105-110/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:26:105-110/r1.claim: After the stories of Moses and Abraham, the account turns to Noah, the first of the foremost prophets; most of his people disbelieved, so God drowned them and saved Noah and the believers with him.
TABATABAI:26:105-110/r1.anchor: وهو أول أولي العزم سادة الأنبياء

TABATABAI:26:105-110/r10.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:26:105-110/r10.speaker: author
TABATABAI:26:105-110/r10.claim: Noah is a trustworthy messenger who conveys only what God commanded; therefore he tells them to fear God and obey him, since obedience to the messenger is obedience to God.
TABATABAI:26:105-110/r10.anchor: أي رسول من الله سبحانه أمين على ما حملته من الرسالة لا أبلغكم إلا ما أمرني ربي

TABRISI:26:105-111/r17.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:26:105-111/r17.speaker: author
TABRISI:26:105-111/r17.claim: Noah is trustworthy in conveying the message between himself and their Lord.
TABRISI:26:105-111/r17.anchor: على الرسالة فيما بيني وبين ربكم

THALABI:v7p172#2/r5.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v7p172#2/r5.speaker: author
THALABI:v7p172#2/r5.claim: Noah is trustworthy in conveying the revelation entrusted to him.
THALABI:v7p172#2/r5.anchor: إني لكم رسول أمين على الوحي فاتقوا الله وأطيعون

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p83/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p83/r3.speaker: ابن عباس ومقاتل
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p83/r3.claim: God entrusted Noah with the message and sent him to his people; he is trustworthy in conveying it between them and their Lord.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p83/r3.anchor: قال ابن عباس: ائتمني الله على رسالته، وبعثني إليكم

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p83/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p83/r4.speaker: الكلبي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p83/r4.claim: Noah had already been trustworthy among his people.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p83/r4.anchor: وقال الكلبي: كان فيهم أمينا قبل ذلك

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512/r3.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512/r3.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512/r3.claim: Noah is trustworthy in delivering what he brought to them.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p512/r3.anchor: {إني لكم رسول أمين} [الشعراء: 107] على ما جئتكم به.

ELMALILI:26:105-122/r4.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:26:105-122/r4.speaker: author
ELMALILI:26:105-122/r4.claim: He tells them he is a messenger sent to them and is trustworthy.
ELMALILI:26:105-122/r4.anchor: Haberiniz olsun ben size gönderilmiş bir resûlüm, bir emînim (107).

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:105/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:105/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:105/r1.claim: Noah’s call has the same essential principles as Moses’s and Abraham’s, and their peoples’ beliefs and responses to true religion were alike; the three narrative groups deliver the same message.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:26:105/r1.anchor: Sonuç itibariyle her üç peygambere dair âyetler grubunda da aynı mesajlar verilmiştir

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p427/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p427/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p427/r4.claim: Calling Noah a trusted messenger shows he is neither a fabricator nor false claimant, but honestly conveys what God commands.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p427/r4.anchor: as God’s messenger, with full honesty he is presenting them what God is asking him to

ALUSI-FULL:v19p107/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p107/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v19p107/r1.claim: Noah is a messenger sent by God for his people's benefit.

ALUSI-FULL:v19p107/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p107/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v19p107/r2.claim: Amin may mean Noah was publicly known among them for trustworthiness, or that he was entrusted with delivering God's message.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p107/r2.anchor: مشهور بالامانة فيما بينكم وقيل : أمين على أداء

BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p121#2/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p121#2/r2.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p121#2/r2.claim: Noah was trustworthy with respect to the revelation.

BAYDAWI-FULL:26:104-110/r5.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:104-110/r5.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:104-110/r5.claim: Noah was known among his people as trustworthy.

BIQAI-FULL:v5p372/r14.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p372/r14.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p372/r14.claim: Noah presents himself as sharing his people’s pain and joy, which grounds his concern that they protect themselves from God’s anger through monotheism.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p372/r14.anchor: مع كوني أخاكم يسوءني ما يسوءكم ويسرني ما يسركم

BIQAI-FULL:v5p372/r15.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p372/r15.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p372/r15.claim: He is a messenger from their Creator and therefore has no option but to convey what he was commanded.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p372/r15.anchor: أي من عند خالقكم , فلا مندوحة لي عند إبلاغ ما أمرت به

BIQAI-FULL:v5p372/r16.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p372/r16.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p372/r16.claim: His people’s long familiarity establishes that he is neither deceitful nor treacherous, so he must deliver the entire message.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p372/r16.anchor: أمين * } أي لا غش عندي كما تعلمون ذلك مني على طول خبرتكم بي

IBNABIHATIM:v8p2787#3/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v8p2787#3/r1.speaker: عبيد بن عمير الليثي
IBNABIHATIM:v8p2787#3/r1.claim: Ubayd ibn Umayr reports that people strangled Noah until he fainted; on recovering he prayed for their forgiveness, and after generations of worsening defiance he complained to God.
IBNABIHATIM:v8p2787#3/r1.anchor: عبيد بن عمير الليثي انه كان يحدث انه بلغه انهم كانوا يبسطونه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r4.claim: Noah’s claim to be a trusted messenger explains his rebuke or exhortation: they persist in polytheism despite his prohibition, although he is their trustworthy messenger.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r4.anchor: تعليل للإنكار أو للتحضيض ، أي كيف تستمرون على الشرك وقد نهيتكم عنه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r5.claim: Noah was known and trusted by his people before his mission, just as Muhammad was called al-Amīn among Quraysh.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r5.anchor: نوح موسوما بالأمانة لا يتهم في قومه كما كان محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r6.speaker: النابغة
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r6.claim: Al-Nābigha’s poetic line presents Noah as one who does not betray trust.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r6.anchor: قال النابغة : كذلك كان نوح لا يخون

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r7.claim: The emphatic إني anticipates that they may challenge Noah’s trustworthiness; his prior record of honesty supports the truth of his message and indirectly rebukes Quraysh for denying Muhammad after calling him trustworthy.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r7.anchor: وتأكيده بحرف التأكيد مع عدم سبق إنكارهم أمانته لأنه توقع حدوث الإنكار

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r8.claim: A possible sense of أمين is that Noah was entrusted by God with the community to which he was sent.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p158/r8.anchor: أن يراد به أمين من جانب الله على الأمة التي أرسل إليها

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p236#2/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p236#2/r4.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p236#2/r4.claim: Noah is trustworthy in conveying God's revelation and message.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p236#2/r4.anchor: وأمين معناه على وحي الله ورسالته

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p133#4/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p133#4/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p133#4/r1.claim: Noah is trustworthy in delivering the message between his people and their Lord.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p133#4/r1.anchor: إني لكم رسول أمين على الرسالة فيما بيني وبين ربكم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p150#3/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p150#3/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p150#3/r4.claim: Noah says he is God's messenger to them, trustworthy in delivering God's message without adding or omitting anything.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p150#3/r4.anchor: إني رسول من الله إليكم، أمين فيما بعثني به، أبلغكم رسالة الله لا أزيد فيها ولا أنقص منها

JISHUMI:v7p5370/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5370/r5.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5370/r5.claim: Amīn means trustworthy, opposite khāʾin; for a messenger, trustworthiness concerns conveying the message.
JISHUMI:v7p5370/r5.anchor: الأمين: من شأنه الأمانة، ونقيضه الخائن، والإيتاء والأمانة في تبليغ الرسالة.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p328#2/r5.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p328#2/r5.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p328#2/r5.claim: Noah was known among his people for honesty, as Muhammad was known among Quraysh.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p328#2/r5.anchor: كان أمينا فيهم مشهورا بالأمانة ، كمحمد صلى الله عليه وسلم في قريش

MUQATIL:26:105-111/r4.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:26:105-111/r4.speaker: author
MUQATIL:26:105-111/r4.claim: Noah is trustworthy in what lies between the people and their Lord.

NASAFI-FULL:v3p191#6/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p191#6/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p191#6/r1.claim: Noah was known among his people for trustworthiness, like Muhammad among Quraysh.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p191#6/r1.anchor: كان مشهورا بالأمانة فيهم كمحمد عليه الصلاة والسلام فى قريش

QURTUBI-FULL:26:106-111/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:26:106-111/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:26:106-111/r2.claim: Noah says he is truthful in conveying God’s message.
QURTUBI-FULL:26:106-111/r2.anchor: { إني لكم رسول أمين } أي صادق فيما أبلغكم عن الله تعالى.

QURTUBI-FULL:26:106-111/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:26:106-111/r3.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:26:106-111/r3.claim: Another view is that Noah was trustworthy among them, whose prior knowledge of his honesty parallels Quraysh’s knowledge of Muhammad.
QURTUBI-FULL:26:106-111/r3.anchor: وقيل: { أمين } فيما بينكم فإنهم كانوا عرفوا أمانته وصدقه من قبل كمحمد صلى الله عليه وسلم في قريش.
